public-flat.description: Flat by default; border and whitespace establish grouping.

public-interactive.description: Border/shadow/color response only; no positional hover lift after layout stabilization.

admin-panel.description: Translucent navy panel over Admin Night with restrained blur and subtle border.

motion.thesis: Illuminated manuscript reveal on the Academy hero; measurable progress animates on acquisition dashboards; admin motion is operational and fast.
rules: No bounce or elastic easing.
No long page-load choreography.
Pause nonessential loops offscreen or while the document is hidden.
Progressive enhancement: content remains visible if JavaScript fails.
Reduced motion removes spatial movement while preserving meaningful state feedback.

narrative.northStar: The Illuminated Study Hall — Emerald Manuscript
rules: Public surfaces are ivory-first; green owns primary action and deliberate dark brand regions.
Scholarly navy is structural/text color, not the default atmospheric dark surface.
Gold is accent/focus; use #8A6D14 when gold-family text is required on light backgrounds.
Admin uses the operational evergreen dark variant with green-first actions.
Typography creates hierarchy before extra borders or cards.
Exactly one localized academic track CTA is visible per active route.
Visual hiding must be matched by correct interaction semantics.
Layout follows the reading/task path; responsive changes structure before localized content collides.
dos: Use IBM Plex Sans Arabic with Tajawal fallback for Arabic-heavy UI.
Preserve RTL/LTR parity and reduced-motion behavior.
Keep track CTAs ivory, green, and gold.
Use evergreen rather than navy for deliberate dark public regions.
donts: Do not use navy as the protected track CTA background.
Do not use raw heritage gold for ordinary-size text on ivory.
Do not invent purple/blue AI gradients or gradient text.
Do not solve hierarchy by nesting additional cards.

colorStrategy.name: Illuminated Emerald Manuscript
colorStrategy.dosage: restrained; strongest color owns action, contact, media, evidence, and admin operation

delight.thesis: Quiet Academic Seal — earned actions feel acknowledged, trustworthy, and clearly advanced to the next step.
moments: Assessment success: persistent emerald/gold confirmation with no fake delay.
Assessment recovery: direct WhatsApp/Telegram continuation when submission fails or is rate-limited.
Acquisition follow-up: useful next-step guidance after success and recovery.
Admin certainty: compact status seal, aria-live feedback, copy confirmation, and calm empty-state mark.
rules: No confetti, mascots, sound, or forced celebration.
Routine clicks do not earn a flourish.
Recovery always leads with the problem and an actionable next path.
Delight must not delay the primary task or add external dependencies.
Reduced-motion, keyboard, touch, screen reader, RTL/LTR, and localization paths remain intact.

overdrive.thesis: Extraordinary continuity and operational certainty with protected geometry.
overdrive.geometryContract: Interaction layers do not own width, height, padding, margin, gap, grid tracks, font-size, or line-height.
enhancements: Fine-pointer hero illumination retained without scroll-cinematic depth.
Gold reading-progress edge uses CSS scroll timeline with JS fallback only.
Interruptible video shared-element morph with inert background and focus return.
Video filter grid transitions with stale-transition cancellation.
Assessment and acquisition aria-busy network states.
Admin semantic keyboard tabs with View Transition panels.
Admin rAF-coalesced search rendering and rollback-safe optimistic request status.
retired: Folio separators and their IntersectionObserver runtime.
Positional hover lift on key public/admin controls.
browserRules: Progressive enhancement only; feature-test advanced APIs.
Reduced motion removes spatial enhancement but keeps state feedback.
No WebGL, particles, sound, or new animation dependencies.
Protected track CTA stylesheet remains last.

hardening.mobileForms: 16px control floor; HTML maxlength/minlength aligned with Firestore rules
hardening.network: localized offline live status; preserve input; explicit uncertain timeout state
hardening.idempotency: session-scoped deterministic assessment document IDs for retry races
hardening.storage: safe browser storage access; allowlisted attribution maps
hardening.remoteData: bounded text/video normalization; realtime unsubscribe on pagehide
hardening.admin: 1000-request per-collection safety cap; 250-video cap; HTTPS URL validation; clipboard fallback
hardening.accessibility: aria-invalid focus recovery; forced-colors visible focus/status states

finalPolish.thesis: Make every accumulated layer feel authored as one system: quieter elevation, calmer highlights, consistent focus, and no new geometry.
rules: No new positional hover lift in the final polish layer.
Protected track CTA remains owned by track-buttons-v6.css and loads last.
Final polish must not alter Firebase, routing, CMS identifiers, or submission behavior.
Prefer border, shadow, opacity, and focus refinement over new decorative layers.
Retain forced-colors and reduced-motion support on every surface family.
